**Type:** RFC · Lite · Discovery Brief · Measured Report · Process change
**Ideas Discussion:**
**Phase in front matter:**

## Author checklist

- [ ] Front matter complete (`phase`, `plane`, `pillar`, `maturity-aspect`, `level`, `decider`)
- [ ] File renamed to this PR's number
- [ ] Developer story shows real commands, config, or screens
- [ ] Discovery baseline linked (Full RFCs)
- [ ] One leading and one lagging metric, each with a baseline (Full RFCs)
- [ ] Drawbacks and "do nothing" alternative written honestly
- [ ] Persona reviews requested (Full RFCs: SRE, first-time developer, security, release manager, future maintainer)

## Decider checklist

*Reviewed on a different day from when the proposal was last edited.*

- [ ] The problem is real and evidenced, not assumed
- [ ] The developer story would make sense to someone outside the project
- [ ] Every persona review has a response
- [ ] Every *Block* in FCP has been answered
- [ ] Graduation criteria are testable
- [ ] Success metrics can be measured the same way at Measured as at Discovery
- [ ] *Decision* section written: outcome, reasons, what would change it
